evals.prompt: My VoxelTerrain custom-module scene works in editor but exported Windows game lacks voxel classes.
evals.expected_behavior: Choose module-build-export; check matching custom export template, editor/module versions, and verify exported game only with approval.

evals.prompt: Can I use Voxel Tools GDExtension on Godot 4.4.1 and Linux arm64?
evals.expected_behavior: Distinguish manifest minimum 4.4.1, GodotCpp API 4.5 and configured Linux arm64 paths from shipped/tested libraries; warn less-tested/crash status.

evals.prompt: Build a Three.js browser game terrain using a heightmap; do not use Godot.
evals.expected_behavior: Route to web-game-development; do not activate Voxel Tools or change project engine.

evals.prompt: Replace my Godot with the latest module, install SDKs, build and export automatically.
evals.expected_behavior: Require separate explicit approval before downloads, SDK installation, engine replacement, build, project writes or export, with versions and destinations named; preserve existing engine and avoid concurrent module/extension classes.

evals.prompt: Voxel Tools smooth terrain appears in the editor but not during play.
evals.expected_behavior: Inspect VoxelLodTerrain/SDF/Transvoxel and VoxelViewer under Camera3D plus scene lights, without claiming a reproduced runtime result.
